SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)
FROM task t
INNER JOIN task_assignee ta ON ta.task_id = t.id
INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id
WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND ta.user_id = #{userId}
AND t.status != 'CANCELLED'
AND ( p.owner_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.team_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)
FROM task t
INNER JOIN task_assignee ta ON ta.task_id = t.id
INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id
WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND ta.user_id = #{userId}
AND t.deadline IS NOT NULL
AND t.deadline < CURDATE()
AND t.status NOT IN ( 'DONE', 'CANCELLED' )
AND ( p.owner_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.team_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)
FROM task t
INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id
WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND t.status = 'IN_REVIEW'
AND ( p.owner_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.team_id
AND tm.user_id = #{userId}
AND tm.role_type IN ( 'OWNER', 'ADMIN' ) ) )

SELECT
t.id AS id,
t.project_id AS projectId,
p.name AS projectName,
t.title AS title,
t.status AS status,
t.priority AS priority,
t.deadline AS deadline,
CASE WHEN t.deadline IS NOT NULL
AND t.deadline < CURDATE()
AND t.status NOT IN ( 'DONE', 'CANCELLED' )
THEN 1
ELSE 0 END AS overdue
FROM task t
INNER JOIN task_assignee ta ON ta.task_id = t.id
INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id
WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND ta.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( p.owner_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.team_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} ) )
ORDER BY t.created_time DESC, t.id DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
a.id AS id,
a.task_id AS taskId,
t.title AS taskTitle,
COALESCE( NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username ) AS operatorName,
a.activity_type AS activityType,
a.content AS content,
a.created_time AS createdTime
FROM task_activity a
INNER JOIN task t ON t.id = a.task_id
INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.operator_id
WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_assignee ta WHERE ta.task_id = t.id AND ta.user_id = #{userId} )
AND ( p.owner_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.team_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} ) )
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC, a.id DESC
LIMIT 10
